services.value: Teklab provides environmental analytical testing services including air and water quality analysis, soil analysis, and specialized testing such as PFAS testing, PCB analysis (including indoor air/PCB testing), hazardous waste testing, VOA/VOC testing, organic and inorganic testing, microbiology (total and fecal coliform), and metals testing (ICP/ICP-MS). It also lists additional methods such as EPA 1666 testing and EPA 524.2 PMI testing for pharmaceutical effluent.
